correctness.rationale: Proved all-domain support classification for m,n >=2, exact signed Walsh formula, complete zero conditions for parity cases, binomial multiplicities with intersection correction, and explicit attainment of sharp smallest nonzero Fourier magnitude. Unnormalized convolution diagonalizes with these integer multipliers. Checker independently enumerated 15,376 integer transforms for m,n=2..6 and weighted 1,521 parameter pairs through 40; the proof, not finite testing, establishes all orders.

originality.rationale: A bounded search and implication comparison found general minimal-dominating-set enumeration theorems and the ordinary complete-multipartite domination polynomial, but not the stated frequency-dependent integer transform, exact binomial Fourier-zero count and resulting two-parameter convolution rank/parity criterion. The prior polynomial counts all dominating sets by cardinality, not signed minimal ones by individual frequencies. Originality is qualified by the full-text access limitation and the possibility of an unlocated multivariate specialization.

value.rationale: The exact nullity/rank across two natural biclique parameters and sharp spectral gap answer a natural invertibility/stability question for a minimal-domination mask. Balanced bicliques have a genuine parity jump from full rank at odd order to a lost fraction exactly 2^-N binom(N,N/2) at even order, asymptotic to sqrt(2/(pi N)). Scalar domination-polynomial counts cannot express this frequency-resolved behavior.
